content: cdn.tailwindcss.com currently redirects to /3.4.17 = Tailwind v3 Play CDN build (verified live). The v4 browser runtime is the separate @tailwindcss/browser package (4.3.3, jsDelivr) with CSS-first config via <style type='text/tailwindcss'> and @theme; it explicitly cannot read JS configs (loadModule throws, so tailwind.config = { darkMode: 'class' } is unsupported) and dark-mode-by-class needs @custom-variant dark. Both Play CDNs are officially development-only. Keeping v3.4.17 preserves the app's exact current dark-mode behavior; v4 migration is a styling change, not a refactor.
